# HR & Admin Audit and Monitoring Tasks

This document details essential tasks for the HR & Admin department, focusing on compliance and policy management:

*   Investigate medical insurance based on audit findings.
*   Monitor medical insurance based on audit findings.
*   Monitor the annual leave standard update.
*   Investigate the bonus structure quarterly.
*   Update the annual leave standard.
